Grit—jab quit karna easy ho tab bhi refuse karna.
Mann ki khamoshi mein, dil ki awaaz sunai deti hai.
Success final nahi, failure fatal nahi—continue ka courage matter karta hai.
Khamoshi wahi hai jahan strength accumulate hoti.
Dhairya kadwa hota hai, lekin iska phal meetha hota hai.
Himmat struggle mein grow karti.
Himmat vijeta ka gun hai.
Darte huye bhi karo.
Shant dimag strong dimag hai.
Khamoshi ki aawaz hi sabse geheri garjan hoti hai.
Darr ke aage badhna hi himmat hai.
Shaant dimaag ko uljhaya ya daraya nahi ja sakta.
Samundar boond-boond se banta hai.
Khamoshi ek panah hai.
Courage hamesha roar nahi karta; kabhi whisper karta.
Grit sab kuch jeet leti hai.
Himmat moments me napti hai.
Khamoshi choose bhi ki ja sakti.
Grit direction ke saath patience hai.
Himmat phir se khade hona hai.
Chup raho; wise raho; brave raho.
